content: To access the main page, click here. Introduction to the Prevention Page The title of the page should be formatted as (Disease name) prevention, with only the first letter of the title capitalized. The purpose of this page is to provide a concise description of the primary methods of prevention for the disease being discussed. At the top of the edit box, include the following: {{CMG}}, your name template, and the microchapter navigation template you created earlier. Ensure that links within WikiDoc are created by enclosing key terms in brackets. These links should be as specific as possible. For instance, if the text mentions anterior spinal artery syndrome, the link should direct to anterior spinal artery syndrome rather than generic terms like anterior, artery, or syndrome. For additional guidance on creating links, click here. Follow the formatting and capitalization guidelines as outlined in the template below. Overview The overview section must include the disease name in the first sentence. The objective of this section is to summarize the primary preventative strategies for the disease in a few sentences. This section can mirror the prevention segment found on the overview page. To view an example of an overview section on a prevention page, click here. Template Primary Prevention Example introductory sentences: If there are no strategies for primary prevention: There are no established measures for the primary prevention of [disease]. There are no available vaccines against [disease]. If there are primary prevention strategies: Effective measures for the primary prevention of [disease] include [specific measures] and [specific measures]. A vaccine is recommended for [specific population] to prevent [disease]. Other primary prevention strategies include [specific measures] and [specific measures]. Secondary Prevention Example introductory sentences: [Provide examples or statements relevant to secondary prevention.] Prevention Provide a detailed description of the key methods for preventing the disease in question, as well as strategies for preventing conditions that predispose individuals to the disease. A reliable source to reference is [source]. For an example of the prevention segment on a prevention page, click here. Methods of prevention should be categorized into primary and secondary prevention measures, as outlined in the microchapter navigation template. To determine the type of preventative measures being described, refer to the guidelines below.
